title: FromHeart Application:
Admin Management System
background: FromHeart is an online ordering app designed to provide users with a seamless way to order teas.
It emphasizes a personalized experience, aiming to simplify the ordering process while maintaining a modern and user-friendly interface.
From the admin's point of view, the system allows easy product management, including creating, updating, and deleting menu items to ensure smooth operational control.
teamNote: This project was created by four people, including myself.
